title: Conversation lessons
summary: Study, listening and writing lessons: an exchange with an AI that ends in a verdict.
description: For what cannot be drilled: a grammar point, a song understood by ear, getting something across in writing. A conversation lesson coming back on its schedule is a check-in.

stories.as: a learner studying a grammar point
stories.want: to be questioned on it and told what to review
stories.soThat: I know whether I understood it

requirements.text: The examiner asks more questions the more complex the lesson: 2 to 3 for low, 4 to 6 for medium, 7 to 10 for high.
A conversation ends with a verdict of pass, partial or fail, with what to review.

A conversation pays `xp.conversation-low`, `xp.conversation-medium` or `xp.conversation-high` for low, medium or high complexity, plus `xp.writing-goal` for each goal a writing lesson has; a partial pays half of that and a fail nothing.

values.description: What a passed conversation of low complexity pays.
What a passed conversation of medium complexity pays.
What a passed conversation of high complexity pays.
What each goal of a writing lesson adds to what its conversation pays.
